faqs.q: How to redeem XTRA Reward Points at fuel stations?
faqs.a: To redeem the accrued XTRA Rewards, first go to one of the participating IndianOil XTRAREWARDS Programme outlets. Then press ‘#’ on the POS machine and choose the ‘Instant Redeem’ option. Next select ‘XTRAREWARDS’ under the ‘Select Program’ section. Click on ‘OK’ and enter the registered mobile number and the desired redemption amount.

faqs.q: On which network is IndianOil RBL XTRA credit card available?
faqs.a: IndianOil RBL XTRA credit card is available in Mastercard and RuPay network variants.

faqs.q: How can I check my XTRA Rewards Points balance?
faqs.a: IndianOil RBL XTRA cardholders can track their XRP balance on https://www.xtrarewards.com or at the participating IOCL Retail outlets from the POS terminal. Card users can also send an SMS query about XRPs to 9223177998 or check the XRP balance on IndianOil ONE app.

faqs.q: Is NCMC service available on IndianOil RBL XTRA credit card?
faqs.a: NCMC functionality is only available with the Rupay variant of IndianOil RBL XTRA credit card.

faqs.question: Is the IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card is worth considering if you regularly refuel at IndianOil fuel stations. It offers up to 8.5% value back on eligible fuel purchases, making it one of the most rewarding IndianOil co-branded credit cards.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card charges a joining and annual fee of ₹1500 + GST. The annual fee is waived on eligible annual spends of ₹2.75 lakh.

faqs.question: What are the fuel benefits of the IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers up to 8.5% value back on eligible fuel purchases, comprising 15 Fuel Points per ₹100 spent (7.5% value back) and a 1% fuel surcharge waiver.

faqs.question: How many Fuel Points can I earn on the IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn 15 Fuel Points per ₹100 on eligible IndianOil fuel purchases, subject to a maximum of 2,000 Fuel Points per month. Other eligible retail spends earn 2 Fuel Points per ₹100.

faqs.question: How do I redeem IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card Fuel Points?
faqs.answer: Fuel Points can be converted into IndianOil XTRAREWARDS Points and redeemed for fuel at participating IndianOil fuel stations with XTRAREWARDS-enabled POS terminals.

faqs.question: Does the IndianOil RBL Bank XTRA Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No. The card does not include complimentary domestic or international airport lounge access.
